falseSynonyms.zh: 新鮮不等於 home-cooked fresh 表示新鮮；餐廳食物可以很新鮮但不是家煮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Freshness and place of preparation are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 健康不等於 home-cooked 家煮食物可以健康，也可以高糖高脂；home-cooked 不保證營養質素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home-cooked does not automatically mean healthy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有機不等於 home-cooked organic 是食材／生產標準；與在哪裏烹調無關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Organic describes production standards, not cooking location.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳統不等於 home-cooked traditional 指文化或歷史做法；家煮菜可以很現代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Traditional and home-cooked overlap only sometimes.

falseSynonyms.zh: home-style 不等於一定 home-cooked 餐廳也可提供 home-style food；它描述風格，不是實際地點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home-style describes style, not where it was cooked.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即食／預製通常與 home-cooked 對比 ready-made 指預先製作、可直接食用或簡單加熱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ready-made food is usually contrasted with home-cooked food.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐廳製作不等於 home-cooked restaurant-made 指由餐廳製作，和家庭廚房來源不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Restaurant-made and home-cooked identify different preparation settings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 home cooking 是名詞片語；home-cooked 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home cooking is a noun phrase; home-cooked is an adjective.
